note: Guinea, read on 2026-10-30 on the visa platform of the Direction Centrale de la Police de l'Air et des Frontières (DCPAF, paf.gov.gn/visa), its tab on the Long Term Visa (VLS); the Spanish Embassy in Conakry's pages on documents and on settling (exteriores.gob.es, undated; secondary, on the DCPAF's card); and France's travel advice for Guinea (updated 15 September 2026). The VLS lasts one year from issue and costs USD 500 (the platform's own currency, so the file's fees are in US dollars), on a work contract approved by the authorities for salaried employment, or an authorisation to practise a liberal profession or to pursue an agricultural, industrial, commercial, artistic or other activity, or proof of marriage or parenthood, or a student's registration, or an internship agreement: one visa for any of these purposes, written as `general`. It is applied for online and collected at the arrival counter, but the page also asks for a copy of the previous visa (a prorogation), so where it is applied for isn't written. The Spanish Embassy says the residence card (carte de séjour) is applied for at the police station of one's place of residence, that it is slow to come so a provisional card is often given, and that it is issued by the DCPAF's residence permits section; it gives no fee, term or renewal, and none is written. France's advice says a foreigner without a residence title and, where needed, a work permit is arrested. Neither page says whether either paper ties its holder to an employer, nor anything of renewal, permanent residence or naturalisation; those are left out.

sources.title: Direction Centrale de la Police de l'Air et des Frontières, Guinea Visa (ETA Electronic Travel Authorisation of Guinea): Long Term Visa (VLS)
sources.said: Long Term Visa (VLS) ... 1 year from the date of issuance. ... USD 500 ... a scanned copy of previous visa (Porogation Visa) ... A contract of employment duly approved by the authorities for foreign nationals desirous of engaging in salaried employment in Guinea ... or an authorization to practice a liberal profession or to promote an agricultural, industrial, commercial, artistic or other activity, issued by the competent authorities, if such an authorization is required ... or a deed evidencing a marital relationship, for a spouse, or a parental relationship for minors ... Apply for your visa online ... Then, proceed to the visa on-arrival counter to get your visa.

sources.title: Embajada de España en Conakry, Documentación y trámites
sources.said: El permiso de residencia (Carte de Séjour) se puede solicitar en las comisarías de policía correspondientes al lugar del domicilio. La obtención del permiso de residencia suele demorarse bastante tiempo, por lo que a menudo se emite un permiso de residencia provisional.

sources.title: Embajada de España en Conakry, Establecerse
sources.said: La autoridad que expide la "Carte de Séjour" es la Direction Générale de la Police Nationale (DGPN)/Direction centrale de la Police de l’Air et des Frontières (DCPAF)/Section Titres de Séjour.

sources.title: France Diplomatie, Guinée: Conseils aux voyageurs, Entrée / séjour
sources.said: Date de mise à jour le : 15 septembre 2026 ... Tout étranger n’étant pas en possession d’un titre de séjour et, le cas échéant, d’un permis de travail, est arrêté.
